objectives.statement: Recall the Bokmål reflexive pronoun forms for each subject group.
Distinguish reflexive pronouns from ordinary object pronouns when comparing who acts and who receives the action.
Build short Bokmål sentences with the correct reflexive pronoun after a finite verb.

notes: Must cover reflexive pronoun forms and contrast reflexive vs ordinary object pronouns, especially seg vs ham/henne/dem and dere vs seg.
